section_summary.extract_value: This Analysis section describes use of Confirmatory Factor Analysis (CFA) and multiple fit indices (χ2, GFI, NFI, CFI, TLI, RMSEA) to evaluate the BAS factorial validity, checks for multivariate normality, and assesses internal consistency with Cronbach's alpha (≥ .70). It also notes evaluation of concurrent/criterion validity via correlations between BAS scores and BMI and group comparisons by weight status using one-way ANOVA; the section does not name any specific study (e.g., 'Study 1') nor report sample demographics or numeric correlation/BMI results.
section_summary.evidence_source: Key sentences: “A structural equation model or Confirmatory Factor  Analysis (CFA) was employed to determine the BAS  factorial validity...” and “Multivariate normality of the data...was verified...” and “The internal consistency was assessed by calculating the Cronbach's alpha coefficient...” and “Evidence of concurrent validity was verified by the existence of consistent and significant correlations between BAS scores and BMI...”
